content: The dual-write problem: writing to your own DB and then separately notifying/writing to another system (queue, second DB, HTTP call) is not atomic -- one can succeed while the other fails, causing silent divergence. The transactional outbox pattern fixes this by writing the 'event to send' into an outbox table in the SAME local transaction as the business data change, then a separate relay/poller (or CDC) reads the outbox and delivers it, retrying until acknowledged. This avoids needing 2PC across services.
